metaDescription: Obsidian is a free note-taking app that stores notes as local Markdown files, with links, a graph view, Canvas and thousands of plugins. See its features, Sync and Publish pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: Obsidian is a note-taking app that stores your notes privately on your device as plain-text Markdown files. You can link notes together, explore connections in a graph view and lay out ideas on Canvas, an infinite space for brainstorming and diagrams.

Obsidian is free for every use, including work, with no account required. With thousands of community plugins and themes, you can shape it to fit how you think. Optional paid services add encrypted sync across devices and publishing notes to the web, and an optional Commercial license lets organizations support development.

features.title: Local Markdown files
features.text: Notes are stored on your device as plain-text Markdown, so you're never locked in.

features.title: Links and graph view
features.text: Link notes together and explore how your ideas connect in a graph.

features.title: Canvas
features.text: An infinite space to research, brainstorm, diagram and lay out ideas.

features.title: Plugins and themes
features.text: Thousands of community plugins and themes to customise the app.

features.title: Obsidian Sync
features.text: Optional end-to-end encrypted sync across devices, with version history.

features.title: Obsidian Publish
features.text: Optional publishing of notes to the web, with no technical knowledge required.

useCases: Linking ideas in a personal wiki
strengths: Free for every use, with no account required.
Your notes are plain Markdown files you own and control.
Works offline, with notes stored on your device.
Available on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS and Android.
limitations: Syncing across devices needs paid Sync or a sync method you set up yourself.
Publishing notes to the web needs paid Publish, priced per site.
Collaborating on shared vaults needs Sync for each collaborator.

pricing.summary: The app is free for personal and commercial use. Sync and Publish are optional paid services, and the Commercial license is optional support for organizations.
